entries.en: to file (with a file/rasp); to grind, to sharpen by whetting
entries.notes: M 栏三音节 cho cu ley 多于汉字栏一字（仅銼），后两音节无对应字录出，不影响「锉＝锉磨磨利」核心释义。

entries.en: to grind a knife on a wheel (rotating grindstone)
to sharpen the knife (navaja: knife or razor)
entries.notes: 汉字首字存疑（录作唱，疑为喙），且音写 huo/hoi 与两字对音皆不合，释义主要依西语 amolar la navaja（磨刀）与末字刀定。

entries.zh: 儆戒；警戒劝诫，兼有纠正、教诲之义
entries.en: to admonish, warn; to correct and instruct
to admonish by word of mouth; to speak, lecture

entries.zh: 讲道；据理训诫（布道训话）
entries.en: to preach; to admonish by discourse/reason

entries.zh: 谕；晓谕、告谕（官方宣示），亦指训诫
entries.en: to instruct by (official) proclamation; to admonish, correct

entries.zh: 安谕；婉言安抚劝导、好言相劝
entries.en: to admonish amicably; to console and gently instruct

entries.zh: 理谕；以理相劝、晓之以理
教谕；谆谆教导、温言劝诫
entries.en: to instruct and admonish with gentleness
entries.notes: R 栏首音 guian 与 M（cau＝教 kau）及汉字「教」对音不合，释义依汉字 教谕 与闽南 kau-sū 定。

entries.zh: 化谕；教化劝谕、感化开导
entries.en: to admonish so as to instruct/transform; to exhort gently
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（amonestar [残] buens.，疑为 con buenas palabras 之类），释义据完整之汉字 化谕 与闽南 hua-sū，故列低置信。

entries.zh: （在教堂内）宣叫将行婚礼者之名，公布结婚预告
entries.en: to proclaim the marriage banns in church; to announce publicly the one about to marry
entries.notes: 汉字首字存疑（录作叫，疑为叼），R 栏中字声调污损（T99）；据 17 世纪马尼拉婚礼预告（amonestaciones）习俗与西语释义定。

entries.en: to pile up, heap; to gather together

entries.zh: 心爱；真心爱慕（发自内心的爱）
entries.en: to love from the heart, love for love's sake; beloved

entries.zh: 私爱；出于一己私意的爱恋
entries.en: private, self-interested love; to love out of one's own desire
entries.notes: 中字音写 guiay 与 已/己 官话对音不合，L 栏仅重出 amor por amor（—为承上符）；据首末二字（私……爱）推断为私意之爱。

entries.zh: 殓；入殓，为死者装殓裹尸
entries.en: to shroud and encoffin the dead; to prepare a corpse for burial
entries.notes: 西语词头 Amorrajâr 疑为 amortajar（装殓裹尸）之误写，释义据汉字 殓 与闽南 liām。

entries.zh: 棺殓；入棺收殓，遗体殓入棺中
entries.en: to place the shrouded body in the coffin; encoffinment of the dead
entries.notes: 西语当读 amortajar q. cuerpo amortajado（装殓；殓毕之遗体），q 为释词省符；释义据 棺殓/kuan-liām。
